caption: The drawing depicts a doll with light skin and blonde hair, styled with a black headband. The main figure shows the doll standing in profile, facing left, with a slightly bent right arm and left foot forward. The doll is dressed in a long, white dress with lace trim along the hem and short sleeves, and is wearing blue shoes. Two smaller rectangular frames are positioned above the main figure: the left frame shows a frontal view of the doll’s head, emphasizing the facial features—blue eyes, red lips, and a faint blush on the cheeks; the right frame displays the back of the doll’s head, highlighting the detailed, wavy texture of the blonde hair. The drawing is signed "Francis Law Durand" in the lower right corner. The background is plain and cream-colored, and there are faint water stains and signs of aging around the edges of the paper.
title: Doll
